    Executive summary

    Mandate: Mix (any). EXPOSURE: not computed - this board froze before the open (as_of 2026-10-12T12:53:04+00:00), and my EXPOSURE lesson binds a board that sits after the open; no figure is printed in its place. Regime: risk-on - SPY 778.57 at the freeze, +1.16% over 5d with trend up, ^VIX 15.51 after a +4.51% day, the US 10-year at 5.24 and the Dollar index at 102.39; the cycle composite projects +2.38% over the next 10 trading days, and CPI plus the MarketWatch bank-earnings preview sit inside this expiry week. The dispatch flags GS and UNH reports this week; my prompt serves no date for either, and neither name ships. Overnight: Asia closed down (-1.28% avg over 3: KOSPI -3.65%, Shanghai Composite -0.43%, Hang Seng +0.25%, the Nikkei 225 stale at -0.02%), Europe is up in session (+0.71% avg over 3: FTSE 100 +0.80%, DAX +0.76%, Euro Stoxx 50 +0.57%), and US futures are flat (-0.07% avg over 2: S&P 500 +0.04%, Nasdaq 100 -0.18%). Asia closed down hard while the futures sit flat and Europe trades up, and the Nasdaq lags the S&P: the regions disagree, the shape that most often retraces. Expected shape: a morning move that retraces and then reclaims. Gap: the dispatch says the gap block prints 'OPEN NOT YET PRINTED'; my prompt's gap_read rows print an open (TSLA: 'open 382.38 vs prior close 375.0'), which the Glazier and the Skeptic read as the stale 2026-10-09 print. My prompt wins on the figure, and no line of mine authors anything from the gap (R73, R87). Conviction is thin: 6 of 10 share lines sit at the 50.0 one-median, only CBOE 58.0 and GOOGL 55.0 separate from the pack, and the option column runs from 57.5 down to 46.0. Both columns are ONE bet - a long-equity tape through 2026-10-15: 10 share longs plus 9 calls, 10 + 9 = 19 lines of 20 long the underlying, with the CVS put the lone short; that is correlation, not a spread of independent bets, and the best expression of it is the room's own top of each column. The pyramid leader is The Black Swan, and its grades carry no extra weight (R33); it diverges from the room on the banks (SHARE=30 on WFC and BAC against one-medians 50.0 and 49.5) and on the WMT contract (78 against the room's 57.5). What kills the day's ideas: SPY closing the session below its 778.57 freeze mark, or ^VIX extending its +4.51% day; either falsifies the long-tape bet both columns make. HOUSE RULES (decided before the open, never mid-session): (1) Stakes - every share line flat at 1.0 (R81); every leg at the 1.0 option default, the desk writing the owner's half on the 4 R4-OVERFLOW legs, with no chair override (R129); no add to any line, and no fresh ticket on a contract an open claim holds. (2) Exits - each leg runs on its EXIT token: a close through the ratchet level lifts that leg's stop to it, a CLOSE through the kill level kills the leg at the next open while an intraday print does not, and whatever is still open is closed at the else close (2026-10-15 for the 2026-10-16 legs, 2026-10-22 for AMZN and TSLA); share lines die only on their invalidation close. (3) Windfall - a leg whose premium closes at 2 x its freeze premium banks half at the first mark the desk serves for that contract and trails the rest at its ratchet; the banked half is never re-staked this week. Desk, R92/R12 - the memo's listings against the persisted book: share: PASS; option: DIFF PRINTED (R92) - UBER memo 57.5 / shipped 55.0, AMZN memo 56.5 / shipped 54.6, TSLA memo 54.0 / shipped 53.8, V memo 54.0 / shipped 53.8, RDDT memo 53.5 / shipped 53.6, PLTR memo 53.0 / shipped 53.4, CCI memo 51.5 / shipped 52.9, CVS memo 51.5 / shipped 52.9, HOOD memo 48.5 / shipped 51.9, SMCI memo 46.0 / shipped 51.0
